name: Double Rollout
description: The foundational trick of balisong flipping. Nearly every other trick builds on this motion — master it before moving on to anything else.

steps.title: Start closed, safe handle in hand
steps.body: Y-grip on the safe handle, latch facing up.

steps.title: Drop the bite handle outward
steps.body: Let it swing away from your body as the blade opens. Keep your grip on the safe handle.

steps.title: Roll it over the back of your hand
steps.body: Let the momentum carry it over. Don't force it — the weight does the work.

steps.title: Catch and close
steps.body: Catch the bite handle as it comes around and reverse the motion to close. That full sequence is the double rollout.

tips.body: Gripping too tightly through the whole motion kills the momentum. Let the knife swing freely — your hand guides, not controls.
